scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes strictly positive mirrored leaf-pair prices, positive bridge price, linear costs, no preset edge weights, and no cardinality or degree constraints.
A unique scalar root specifies the no-bridge regime; no general radicals are claimed for it.

A July 24-28, 2006 conference version of the foundational source exists, but its precise first public release day was not verified; 2008-02-01 is the earliest day-verified electronic release of the inspected complete source, not a claim of no earlier circulation.
No claim of publication priority can be guaranteed by finite indexed search.
title: A sharp shunt-price threshold for heterogeneous two-hub resistance networks
